name: So Speaks She Who Lives In Her Name

system.description: So Speaks She Who Lives In Her Name permanently alters the costs and mechanics of the Infernal's She Who Lives In Her Name Excellency suite. The First She Who Lives In Her Name Excellency now provides two dice per mote spent rather than one, and the Second She Who Lives In Her Name Excellency now provides one automatic success per mote spent rather than one per two motes. She Who Lives In Her Name Inevitability Technique no longer requires a Willpower expenditure, costing four motes instead. So Speaks She Who Lives In Her Name is incompatible with Effortless She Who Lives In Her Name Dominance.
